# Recipes

Saved compositions with named slots: starting points for routine slides, and what draft mode and template-fill fill.
`slides_view {what: "expand"}` returns the composition behind one so you can rework it.

- `title/left-anchored` — Large left-aligned title with subtitle and date, low on the page. Slots: `title`, `subtitle?`, `kicker?`, `date?`.
- `title/centred` — Centred title and subtitle. Slots: `title`, `subtitle?`, `kicker?`, `date?`.
- `title/split` — Title on the left, image bleeding off the right. Slots: `title`, `subtitle?`, `kicker?`, `image`.
- `section/number-led` — Section divider led by a large number. Slots: `title`, `number?`, `lead?`.
- `section/full-colour` — Section divider on an accent band. Slots: `title`, `lead?`.
- `agenda/list` — Numbered agenda list beside the title. Slots: `title`, `items[2–8]`.
- `agenda/strip` — Agenda as a horizontal strip of numbered cards. Slots: `title`, `items[2–6]`.
- `statement/big-claim` — One claim, set large, with optional support. Slots: `statement`, `support?`, `kicker?`.
- `bullets/one-column` — Title and a single column of points. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `points`, `takeaway?`.
- `bullets/two-column` — Title and points flowing into two columns. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `points`.
- `comparison/columns` — Two to four options compared side by side, with an optional verdict each. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `groups[2–4]`.
- `comparison/before-after` — Before and after, the after emphasised. Slots: `title`, `before`, `after`, `beforeLabel?`, `afterLabel?`.
- `metrics/row` — Two to five metrics in a row with labels. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `metrics[2–5]`, `takeaway?`.
- `metrics/grid` — Up to six metrics on cards in a wrapping grid. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `metrics[2–6]`.
- `metrics/hero` — One hero number with supporting metrics beside it. Slots: `title`, `hero`, `metrics[0–3]`.
- `chart/with-takeaways` — A chart with up to three takeaways beside it. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `chart`, `takeaways?`.
- `chart/full` — A full-width chart under its title. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `chart`, `source?`.
- `table/standard` — A table under its title. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `table`, `takeaway?`.
- `table/compact` — A denser table using the whole content area. Slots: `title`, `table`.
- `timeline/horizontal` — Dated events along a horizontal rule. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `events[2–7]`.
- `timeline/vertical` — Dated events down the page. Slots: `title`, `events[2–10]`.
- `process/chevrons` — Steps in a row of cards joined by chevrons. Slots: `title`, `kicker?`, `steps[2–7]`.
- `process/numbered` — Numbered steps down the page. Slots: `title`, `steps[2–8]`.
- `process/flow` — Connected nodes laid out as a flow graph. Slots: `title`, `nodes`, `edges?`.
- `roadmap/now-next-later` — Three horizons with items in each. Slots: `title`, `groups[2–4]`.
- `matrix/quadrant` — A 2×2 of four labelled quadrants. Slots: `title`, `quadrants[4–4]`.
- `diagram/layered` — A layered architecture or dependency diagram. Slots: `title`, `nodes`, `edges?`.
- `image/half-bleed` — Image bleeding off one half, text on the other. Slots: `title`, `body?`, `image`.
- `image/full-bleed-caption` — Full-bleed image with a caption band. Slots: `title`, `image`.
- `quote/pull` — A pull quote with attribution. Slots: `quote`, `attribution?`.
- `people/grid` — Team members with roles. Slots: `title`, `people[1–8]`.
- `case/challenge-solution-result` — Challenge, solution, and result in three columns. Slots: `title`, `challenge`, `solution`, `result`.
- `tiers/columns` — Two to four tiers with features. Slots: `title`, `groups[2–4]`.
- `risks/table` — Risks with likelihood, impact, and mitigation. Slots: `title`, `table`.
- `decision/recommendation` — Options considered and the recommended one, with the ask. Slots: `title`, `groups[2–3]`, `statement`, `ask?`.
- `qa/two-column` — Questions and answers. Slots: `title`, `pairs[1–6]`.
- `sources/list` — References. Slots: `title`, `sources`.
- `closing/call-to-action` — Closing call to action with next steps and contact. Slots: `title`, `actions?`, `contact?`.

Presets (draft themes, always labelled): `draft/calm`, `draft/confident`, `draft/editorial`, `draft/technical`, `draft/warm`, `draft/bold`, `draft/minimal`, `office/safe`.
